params.name: id
params.description: Article ID (returned as id in feed/search results)

items.docs: Returns the full content of a single news article by its ID (returned as `id` in feed and search results).

params.name: project
params.description: Comma-separated project names to filter by

params.name: from
params.description: Filter articles published on or after this time. Accepts Unix seconds or date string (2024-01-01)

params.name: to
params.description: Filter articles published on or before this time. Accepts Unix seconds or date string (2024-02-01)

params.name: sort_by
params.description: Sort order: recency (newest first) or trending (deterministic newest-first alias until engagement ranking is available)

items.docs:
Returns crypto news from major sources.

**Filters:** `source` (enum), `project`, and time range (`from`/`to`).

**Sort:** `recency` (default) or `trending`.

Use the detail endpoint with article `id` for full content.
